name: YoRHa Member (Rasta bar)
about: Given by this NPC in the Rasta bar when you talk to them; the later steps are rewards of the quests each item opens.

rows.note: chain: 14245 YoRHa Request ① -> quests 40221, 40225 -> 14281 YoRHa Request ② -> quests 40223, 40226 -> 14282 YoRHa Request ③ -> quests 40224, 40227
rows.when: Talk to the YoRHa Member and accept the request; only while you hold none; client patch after v1.25 (part 174)

rows.note: step 2 of the YoRHa Member's request (Rasta bar): reward of quests 40221, 40225, which take 14245 YoRHa Request ①
step 3 of the YoRHa Member's request (Rasta bar): reward of quests 40223, 40226, which take 14281 YoRHa Request ②
